Introduction

Youngseo is a South Korean Singer under The Black Label. She is the main vocalist and maknae of co-ed group ALLDAY PROJECT, with whom she debuted with on June 23, 2025, with the single "FAMOUS".

In 2023, Youngseo gained recognition for her participation in the survival show R U Next?, where she ranked second and was chosen to debut in the group ILLIT. However, Youngseo left the group after coming to a mutual agreement to terminate her contract with Belift Lab on January 4, 2024.
